speech.heard: Mongolia generates 84.0554% of its electricity from coal. The UK generates just 0.0991%. Botswana is the world's highest. Botswana produces 95.4386% of all its electricity from coal. Across southern Africa, South Africa generates 85.0182%, while the USA produces 17.1904%. In Southeast Asia, Indonesia generates 70.5202% of its power from coal. China generates 58.5532% of its total electricity production from coal. What does your country stand?
